hooks.command: TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); if ! grep -q "## $TODAY" PROGRESS.md 2>/dev/null; then echo "Session complete — please update PROGRESS.md now. Add a new entry at the very top of the log (below the ---) dated $TODAY, following the existing template: Done / In progress / Notes. Summarise what changed this session, what is still open, and any decisions made. Then commit and push the file."; exit 2; fi; exit 0
